# Migration Intentions - v1.4.0

## Intentions

<!-- boilerstone:intentions:begin — generated by `pnpm boilerplate intentions sync`, do not edit -->

- [`00-api-entity-factories.md`](./00-api-entity-factories.md) — `migration` · `api` — The API has one MikroORM `Factory` class per entity in `<module>.factory.ts`, and tests and seeders build their data with them.
- [`01-build-release-images-from-release-please.md`](./01-build-release-images-from-release-please.md) — `migration` · `ci` — Merging the Release PR builds the version images (`X.Y.Z`, `X.Y`, `latest`) of every app, and `PROMOTE_ON_RELEASE` deploys them, all from the Release Please run. — requires `v1.1.0/adopt-release-please`
- [`02-gitattributes-generated-client.md`](./02-gitattributes-generated-client.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — GitHub collapses the committed OpenAPI client in pull request diffs and leaves it out of the repository's language stats.
- [`03-lint-one-entity-per-file.md`](./03-lint-one-entity-per-file.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — Every `apps/api/**/*.entity.ts` declares at most one class, and oxlint fails when one declares more. — requires `v1.0.0/standardize-oxlint-oxfmt`
- [`04-pr-lint-root-install.md`](./04-pr-lint-root-install.md) — `migration` · `ci` — The `PR title and description` job installs only the root package, so it no longer installs every app of the monorepo. — requires `v1.1.0/adopt-conventional-commits`
- [`05-ui-base-ui-finish.md`](./05-ui-base-ui-finish.md) — `migration` · `frontend` — `packages/ui` depends on no `@radix-ui/*` package, its components compose through Base UI's `render` prop instead of `asChild`, and the agent guidance names Base UI.
- [`06-verify-email-once.md`](./06-verify-email-once.md) — `migration` · `frontend` — The web-spa's verify-email page sends `authClient.verifyEmail` once per token, even when React's StrictMode runs its mount effect twice.

<!-- boilerstone:intentions:end -->
